slug: 2025-07-01 Djibouti Digital Code adopted by National Assembly

facts.fact: Jones Day reports that on 30 June 2025 the National Assembly passed the Digital Code (eight volumes, nearly 800 articles, covering e-commerce, cryptology service providers, data protection and cybersecurity), and that the law was still to be promulgated by the President and published in the Journal Officiel, and to be supplemented by regulatory decrees.
